evidenceRequired: Provider reliability and robustness test reports (EV-A50-20)
Auditor reliability test set and results (EV-A50-21)
items.objective: Test the reliability and robustness of the marking and detection solution against independent samples (A50-P-02C), the provider's process for keeping Art 50(2) compliance under control (A50-P-02E), and every exception or carve-out claimed under Art 50(2) (A50-P-02F; the guidance-only carve-outs are pending legal review, LR-A50-03). Kept apart from WP-XC-10 because a paper records at most 30 steps.

procedures.text: A50-P-02C-S01 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-20): Inspect the provider's test reports: metrics, positives and negatives (including other AI systems' outputs), data not used in development, strata by length, size, diversity and semantics, transformation battery, threat model and dates.

A50-P-02C-S02 (analytical_review; evidence EV-A50-21, EV-A50-22): Pre-register the plan before testing: strata, bands (declared performance with tolerance, or methodology defaults), transformations and parameters, sample sizes, family size and confidence level.

A50-P-02C-S03 (reperformance; sampling SR-A50-03; evidence EV-A50-21): Reliability: detect marks on unaltered marked outputs (detection rate) and on unmarked human-made and other-AI content (false-positive rate); compute Wilson intervals per stratum.

A50-P-02C-S04 (reperformance; sampling SR-A50-04; evidence EV-A50-22): Robustness to common processing: apply the pre-registered battery (in-place modifications such as noise, filtering, recompression, screenshots, format change, voice enhancement, lexical substitution and homoglyphs; desynchronisation such as cropping, mirroring, rescaling, rotation, pitch shift, time stretch, character edits, paraphrase and translation round-trips; the analogue hole such as print-and-scan, playback-and-record and camcording; localised edits such as face blurring) and measure detection and metadata survival per transformation.

A50-P-02C-S05 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-23): Adversarial robustness: inspect the provider's assessment of copying, removal, regeneration and modification attacks and its integrity checks; where written authorisation exists, run limited attacks in an isolated environment, never on the platform.

A50-P-02C-S06 (reperformance; sampling SR-A50-04; evidence EV-A50-23, EV-A50-21): Integrity: test that a mark copied onto human-made content, or an altered metadata assertion, is detected as tampered where the provider claims integrity verification.

A50-P-02C-S07 (recomputation; evidence EV-A50-21, EV-A50-22, EV-A50-20): Compare independent results with declared figures; report every member's estimate and interval, including descriptive members without a band.

A50-P-02E-S01 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-26): Inspect the documented compliance process and, where marking or detection comes from an upstream model provider or a third party, their documentation and the provider's own verification of it.

A50-P-02E-S02 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-26, EV-A50-20): Inspect pre-release and periodic test records under representative conditions, the benchmark used, and whether each model or system release was re-tested.
A50-P-02E-S03 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-26): Trace reported or detected shortcomings (including any found by this audit) to corrective actions and their timeliness.
A50-P-02E-S04 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-26): Inspect training records for staff responsible for marking and detection, and records of cooperation with market surveillance authorities.
A50-P-02F-S01 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-27, EV-A50-04): Obtain the register of features claimed to be standard editing or non-substantial alteration, with the rationale.

A50-P-02F-S02 (reperformance; sampling SR-A50-06; evidence EV-A50-27): Sample input and output pairs of each claimed feature and judge semantic change against the guidelines' examples (summaries, rewriting that changes style or meaning, object or face replacement and voice synthesis require marking; grammar fixes, format conversion, minor colour or crop changes do not); use a second reviewer for borderline items.

A50-P-02F-S03 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-27, EV-A50-13): Check that outputs classed as out of scope (short sequences, source code, machine-to-machine, intermediate production outputs) are really so, and that final workflow outputs are marked. Perform only where the classification answers yes to "Exclusion relied on (guidance only): every output is outside Art 50(2)"; where it answers no, record the step as not performed with that reason; an unknown answer is resolved first.

A50-P-02F-S04 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-04): Where the industrial or business-to-business carve-out is claimed, test its three cumulative conditions, including technical safeguards such as cloud isolation and role-based access, and that the system is neither public nor consumer-facing. Perform only where the classification answers yes to "Exclusion relied on (guidance only): industrial B2B use meeting point 87"; where it answers no, record the step as not performed with that reason; an unknown answer is resolved first.

A50-P-02F-S05 (observation; evidence EV-A50-04, EV-A50-09): Where the ephemeral real-time carve-out is claimed, confirm nothing is recorded, stored or disseminated, that marking is infeasible, and that in-experience disclosure is shown. Perform only where the classification answers yes to "Exclusion relied on (guidance only): real-time ephemeral output, persons told"; where it answers no, record the step as not performed with that reason; an unknown answer is resolved first.

A50-P-02F-S06 (inspection; evidence EV-A50-30): Where the law-enforcement exception is claimed, inspect the law and the deployment it covers; other uses of the same system remain in scope. Perform only where the classification answers yes to "Exception relied on: use authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences"; where it answers no, record the step as not performed with that reason; an unknown answer is resolved first.

fail: A50-P-02C-C01 or C02 fails for a member: the independent interval lies wholly outside the declared band.
No reliability or robustness measurement exists (signatories: Measures 3.2, 3.3 and 4.2 are mandatory).
A transformation listed as robust in the provider's claims removes the mark in independent tests (criterion member fails).
inconclusive: An interval straddles its band.
Adversarial testing not authorised: the limitation is stated and adversarial robustness rests on the provider's evidence.
pass: A50-P-02C-C01 and C02 pass for every member.
The provider measures reliability and robustness as Measures 3.2 and 3.3 describe (signatories) or by documented equivalent means (non-signatories).
procedures.title: Reliability and robustness of marking and detection (Art 50(2), second sentence)

fail: No testing before placing on the market or after material changes (Measure 4.2 for signatories).
Known shortcomings left uncorrected.
inconclusive: Records incomplete for part of the period: limitation stated.
pass: A current compliance process covers every output path; testing happened before release and periodically; shortcomings were corrected.
procedures.title: Marking compliance, testing and monitoring process (Art 50(2); Code Commitment 4)

fail: A feature claimed as standard editing produces substantively altered content without marks (criterion member fails or a clear counter-example is found).
A carve-out relied on whose conditions are not met.
inconclusive: A50-P-02F-C01 straddles its band.
pass: Every exception or carve-out relied on is supported, and A50-P-02F-C01 passes for each claimed feature.
